verdict.rationale: Mastercard documents an official MCP server, the Agent Toolkit on developer.mastercard.com. It connects to AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and Windsurf, and covers Open Finance integration questions (e.g., verifying account ownership and checking balances). However, the evidence presents it as a developer-assistance server for contextual docs answers and code generation, not one exposing live Open Finance operations such as account or transaction data to agents. missing for 10: evidence that the MCP server can call Open Finance APIs (accounts, balances, transactions) on a user's behalf, setup/auth details for the MCP connection, independent or hands-on corroboration.
